Class TypstConverter

java.lang.Object
org.asciidoctor.converter.AbstractConverter<String>
org.asciidoctor.converter.StringConverter
network.ike.docs.typst.asciidoc.TypstConverter
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.asciidoctor.converter.Converter<String>, org.asciidoctor.converter.OutputFormatWriter<String>, org.asciidoctor.log.Logging, org.asciidoctor.log.LogHandler
public class TypstConverter extends org.asciidoctor.converter.StringConverter
AsciidoctorJ converter for the typst backend: walks the Asciidoctor AST and emits Typst source.

Coverage (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1307 spike): document title and attributes, sections to any depth, paragraphs, emphasis / strong / monospace, ordered, unordered and description lists, listings and literal blocks, admonitions, tables with cols proportions and a repeating header row, footnotes (native footnote), in-document cross references (link to a label), index terms (as metadata labelled <ike-index>), bibliography anchors and citations (plain), images (image() in a figure), stem blocks (LaTeX through the mitex package) and passthrough blocks with the role typst, whose content is Typst source placed verbatim: titled, it is a captioned figure; with the role drawing as well, it is fitted to the column through ike-drawing, which is how the [decision-tree] block's tree and tornado arrive from koncept-asciidoc-extension. Anything else, a passthrough of HTML included, renders as a visibly marked literal fallback, never silently dropped.

Koncept inline macros arrive as quoted phrase nodes carrying the role koncept (see KonceptInlineMacro's typst branch) and render through ike-koncept from the page setup.
